## 1. Introduction and Scope

The architecture proposed by Pesaranghader, Pesaranghader, Matwin, and Sokolova (2018) addresses a well-known scalability problem in Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD): conventional supervised systems train one classifier per ambiguous word, which becomes impractical when a language or technical domain contains many ambiguous terms ([Pesaranghader et al., 2018](https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.09059)).
